verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI offers conversation checkpointing to save/resume sessions and GEMINI.md custom context files that persist project context, but these require manual save/resume and manual authoring rather than the agent automatically building and recalling memory across sessions. A community report also notes GEMINI.md is sometimes ignored despite being loaded, undermining reliability of even this manual context mechanism. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic, agent-driven long-term memory formation/recall without user intervention, and confirmation that context persistence works reliably in practice.
